title: Chapter 1537 - 634: Chun Yangzi vs Shi Heng True Monarch
content:
Chapter 1537: Chapter 634: Chun Yangzi vs Shi Heng True Monarch

Ning Zhuo didn’t speak, just focused intently on the battle.

Chun Yangzi’s Positive Magical Power was extremely pure, completely different from the Nine Fire Dragon Lord’s nine fires.

If the Nine Fire Dragon Lord’s Fire Techniques were ever-changing, complex, and fierce, like a Ten Thousand Fire Pill Furnace, then Chun Yangzi’s mana was unified, majestic, clear, and pure, like the scorching midday sun.

Shi Heng True Monarch was not moved by the opening setback.

He gripped the Big Axe with both hands and swung it heavily toward the ground.

Boom!

The ground of the Thick Earth Martial Arts Arena shook violently. Dozens of stone pillars emerged from below, rising up like a forest or formation, enclosing Chun Yangzi at the center.

Spiritual Patterns flickered on the surface of the stone pillars, and each one emitted an earthy yellow halo. The halos overlapped like heavy chains, aiming for Chun Yangzi’s shoulders, wrists, and waist.

The golden light around Chun Yangzi sank, and the ground beneath his feet slightly sank as well.

Shi Heng True Monarch shouted fiercely, "Suppress!"

The Yellow Flag fluttered violently in mid-air, with dust swirling over its surface.

The earthy yellow halo suddenly tightened, and a creaking sound of friction filled the air, like invisible mountains pressing against golden iron.

Chun Yangzi had to halt in place.

His sleeves drooped, and the golden light was confined within three feet around him. The Pure Yang aura remained bright but no longer spread outward as before.

In the Territorial Expansion Alliance Seat, someone clenched their fists and murmured, "It’s done!"

At the White Cloud Village Seat, You Yunshou squinted.

Ning Zhuo’s brow furrowed slightly.

Shi Heng True Monarch’s tactics were not ingenious, yet extremely fitting for this venue. The ground of the Thick Earth Martial Arts Arena was already heavy with Earth Power, and with the stone pillars forming a forest, the halo suppression, and the Yellow Flag drawing on Earth Power, Chun Yangzi’s Yang Energy, if unable to rise and release outward, would be like the sun trapped in a mountain belly, turning the situation unfavorable.

Chun Yangzi suddenly chuckled, "Not bad tactics, simple yet fitting for you."

Shi Heng True Monarch did not reply, only clenched his teeth and pressed firmly on the Big Axe.

The earthy yellow halo descended layer by layer, pressing the ground under Chun Yangzi’s feet to crack, sending stones flying, which were then burned into fine dust by the golden light.

Chun Yangzi raised his right hand.

His fingers were long, and a point of golden light condensed at his fingertip.

That point of golden light was small but extremely bright, painfully glaring to look at directly.

Chun Yangzi softly said, "One Yang Birth."

As his words fell, that point of golden light rose like the first ray of Yang Energy from a winter solstice night.

It floated slowly skyward.

It wasn’t fierce, yet unstoppable!

The earthy yellow halo met this point of golden light and began to dissolve layer by layer.

The golden light sprouted like a new shoot from the winter soil; the earth’s crust remained, but a strong vitality had already broken through the ground.

The first halo dissipated.

The second, third halo dissipated.

Shi Heng True Monarch’s expression changed dramatically, fully urging the Yellow Flag.

More Earth energy surged out, thickening the halo again, and the stone pillars emitted a dull hum as if the entire Thick Earth Martial Arts Arena was assisting in suppressing Chun Yangzi.

But that point of golden light had already emerged and was not easily extinguished.

Chun Yangzi stepped forward.

Crack!

The soil and rocks beneath him split open, releasing endless golden light from the cracks, as if a vein of golden light lay hidden underground.

The second step.

Fine cracks began to appear on the surfaces of the stone pillars, emitting golden rays from within!

The third step.

A faint sun wheel appeared behind Chun Yangzi. Although not large, it was perfect and round. The golden radiance shone upon his hair crown, shoulders, and sleeves, giving him an almost divine and majestic aura.

Shi Heng True Monarch’s eyes reddened, feeling an overwhelming oppressive force.

"Can’t suppress it!" He was decisive, quickly lifting the Big Axe, shattering the ground, and charging toward Chun Yangzi.

His speed wasn’t fast, but each step made the Martial Arts Arena tremble!

The Big Axe scraped along the ground, carving a deep furrow. Earth light surged within the furrow, like a yellow Earth Dragon following behind him.

Chun Yangzi neither dodged nor retreated, staying put.

He flipped his right palm, revealing a golden short sword.

The short sword had no sheath, its blade clear as if formed by Sunlight. The blade was not wide, yet extremely upright. Its appearance pushed the heavy Earth Power in the Martial Arts Arena half a foot away.

Earth Element Magic—Shrinking Earth into Inches!

Shi Heng True Monarch had already charged, sweeping the Big Axe horizontally.

Woo!

The axe wind was dense, sweeping up large chunks of earth and stones. Countless stones were driven by the axe wind, whistling like rain, some striking the Array Light Curtain, causing it to flicker.

Chun Yangzi slashed vertically with the short sword.

Golden light clashed with the Big Axe.

Clang!

The sound was extremely loud, like a bronze bell striking a mountain.

Golden sparks and yellow Earth light scattered, shooting several feet high, like a grand display of fireworks.

The airwaves swept in all directions.

Nearby stone pillars were caught in the aftermath, shattering into segments on the spot.

The broken columns collapsed, hitting the ground and raising waves of dust.

Shi Heng True Monarch’s arms shook violently, the tiger’s mouth split open, blood flowing down the axe handle.

He took a step back, shocked at Chun Yangzi’s strength, then used the force of the axe being rebounded to spin and slash again.

Second axe.

Third axe.

Fourth axe!

Each axe was heavier than the last.

His tenacity was amazing, like a mountain rock continually baked by the scorching sun, yet never fully cracking.

Chun Yangzi’s short sword slashed repeatedly, golden light streaming.

Each sword light descended gloriously, without any sense of sinister cunning.

Sword rays attacked straightforwardly, like the midday sun, leaving no shadow hidden.

Shi Heng True Monarch and Chun Yangzi exchanged tens of blows, and Shi Heng’s earthy yellow short robe was cut with several slits by the sword light, with burnt black sword marks on his shoulders, chest, and left arm.

Ultimately, he couldn’t sustain it, retreating proactively to create distance.

Chun Yangzi remained standing, surprisingly not in pursuit.
